name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to small and marginal farmer families.

almost_eligible_hints.land_holding_hectares: Your land holding must be under 2.0 hectares. If you jointly own land, partition records (7/12 extract) showing your individual share may bring you within the limit.
almost_eligible_hints.has_bank_account: You need a bank account linked to Aadhaar. Nearest Jan Dhan Yojana center or post office can open one same-day.
almost_eligible_hints.has_aadhaar: Aadhaar enrollment is mandatory. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra for enrollment.
almost_eligible_hints.occupation: Scheme is strictly reserved for agricultural landholder farmers.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
description: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month directly transferred to women residents of Maharashtra.

almost_eligible_hints.annual_income: Annual family income must be under ₹2.5 Lakh. You will require an official Tehsildar income certificate or yellow/orange ration card.
almost_eligible_hints.age: Applicant must be between 21 and 65 years of age on the date of application.
almost_eligible_hints.gender: This scheme is exclusively for women residing in Maharashtra.
almost_eligible_hints.has_bank_account: An active Aadhaar-seeded bank account (DBT enabled) is required.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development / Rural Development Dept Maharashtra
description: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh to construct a pucca house with basic amenities.

almost_eligible_hints.owns_pucca_house: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India.
almost_eligible_hints.annual_income: Income ceiling requires BPL/SECC categorization. Contact your Gram Panchayat to verify your SECC 2011 priority listing.

name: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
description: Additional top-up grant of ₹6,000 per year from Maharashtra Government to PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers.

almost_eligible_hints.occupation: Beneficiary must be registered under PM-KISAN in Maharashtra.
almost_eligible_hints.land_holding_hectares: Must hold verifiable agricultural land up to 2.0 Ha on your 7/12 extract.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
department: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Maharashtra
description: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 to destitute persons, blind, disabled, and senior citizens.

almost_eligible_hints.age: Senior citizen eligibility starts at 65 years. Alternatively, a 40%+ disability certificate exempts the age requirement.
almost_eligible_hints.annual_income: Destitute income limit is strictly ₹21,000/year, certified by the Tehsildar.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 starting at age 60 for unorganized sector workers.

almost_eligible_hints.age: Entry age for APY is strictly between 18 and 40 years. For individuals above 40, explore PM-SYM or NPS Lite.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
description: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove provided to adult women of poor households.

almost_eligible_hints.gender: LPG connection under Ujjwala 2.0 can only be issued in the name of an adult woman member of the household.
almost_eligible_hints.caste_category: General category households require a verified BPL ration card or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) enrollment.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojana
department: Co-operation, Marketing and Textiles Department, Maharashtra
description: Debt waiver and incentive relief up to ₹50,000 for farmers regularly repaying short-term crop loans.

almost_eligible_hints.occupation: Applicable strictly to farmers holding short-term crop loans (Pik Karj) in cooperative or commercial banks in Maharashtra.
